source.source_description: Widmaier et al.; 31,702 manufacturer-polynomial GENERATED + 371 measured compressor records

observations.why_not_direct_validation: Different compressor and reference displacement; experimental overall isentropic efficiency is defined using ELECTRICAL input, while WP7 idealized h2s-h1/eta uses assumed internal compression efficiency and omits motor and auxiliary power. Measured pressure/speed/geometry and heat-pump system topology are not matched. EN12900 rows are generated.

source.source_description: Leclercq; 200 cm^3 two-phase/oil-mixed R1233zd(E) scroll compressor laboratory data

observations.why_not_direct_validation: Two-phase inlet and lubricating oil mixture in 200cm3 scroll unit; WP7 assumes dry superheated suction and a separate implied compressor displacement. Use only for conditional context on variability, not 310kW design calibration.
